paper_title: Properties of Ultralight Bosons from Heavy Quasar Spins via Superradiance
notes: From Figure 6 (mu-f_axion plane), the paper's bound on the axion decay constant f_a for scalar/axion-like ULBs from black-hole superradiance self-interaction (Eqs 4.1-4.2, Tables 2-3 of measured+calculated AGN spins). Curve is the lower envelope (bottom outline) of the union of the per-BH excluded regions, extracted from the vector fill polygons of the shipped figure PDF (axiondecayconstantvsmass.pdf) and converted to canonical 1/f_a = 1/f_min at each mass. NOTE the exclusion is INVERTED relative to usual axion limits: non-observation of superradiance excludes LARGE f_a (weak self-interaction), so the excluded region lies at 1/f_a BELOW this boundary (small 1/f_a), between the curve and 1/f_a=1/(10^18 GeV) plot cap. Reported points are the boundary values 1/f_min(mu). Mass exclusion range for scalars is 2.9e-21-1.7e-17 eV assuming negligible self-interaction (Fig 3). Spin lower bounds quoted at 2-sigma. The paper also gives analogous vector (Fig 7) and spin-2 (Fig 8) decay-constant bounds; scalar/axion Fig 6 chosen as the axion result. Limit independent of DM density.
